label: B25-M20K-MERGE-GATE-D
title: Run complete Gate D on the M20K-corrected integration candidate
writes: build/difftest/** ignored Gate D products inside the isolated worktree
build/coverage/** ignored coverage products inside the isolated worktree
scope: In a detached/frozen worktree at the exact M20K-corrected integration SHA, run the complete release-mode Gate D with parallel batches, assertions and all QEMU comparisons enabled.
validation: VERILATOR_JOBS=1 bash sim/difftest/run_gate_d.sh --parallel, including make test, coverage, M2/R1, delay2, P5a hardening/MMU, Gate C, P4b, three 100k random seeds, coverage accounting and baremetal-C.
acceptance: Every Gate D group passes on the exact frozen SHA; random traces and coverage artifacts exist; no assertion, comparison, test or baremetal requirement is disabled.
resource: Acquire local with >=8192 MiB admission. Return 75 means wait. Planner parallel batches may use the exclusive host but VERILATOR_JOBS remains 1 per build.
forbidden_regions: test skip, expected-result change or assertion disable
GamePC, Quartus, assembler, JTAG, board, JIC/EPCQ/Flash/reset/power
next_after_acceptance: Gate D releases the corrected no-FP bring-up physical result to its assembler/SOF gate; it does not itself establish physical or board correctness.
